description: Defines the Http2PriorityDependencies class for managing HTTP/2 stream priorities in the Chromium project, including stream creation, destruction, and priority updates.

classes.name: Http2PriorityDependencies
classes.description: Manages HTTP/2 stream priorities, including creation, destruction, and updates, with internal data structures for efficient priority management.

methods.name: OnStreamCreation
methods.description: Handles logic when a new stream is created, determining parent stream, weight, and exclusivity.

methods.name: OnStreamDestruction
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a stream is destroyed.

methods.name: OnStreamUpdate
methods.description: Processes priority changes for a stream and returns dependency updates to send to the server.
